items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: through another friend, Joe Alexander, who was also on that label

ctx.x: It was broadcast. So he -- the whole six hours I think was broadcast -- so he heard the show and he contacted me in the next few days through another friend, Joe Alexander, who was also on that label. Joe Alexander was a marvelous vocalist and a bass player, but he was a better vocalist than he was a musician, really. And he was on the label. So he contacted me and told me that Mr. Dexter from

Capitol Records wanted to hear from me, wanted me to get in touch with him. Well, I didn't do it right away. I hesitated. It was two or three days. Because I had been disappointed. And I said, well, two or three days after that, I said well, I'll give Mr. Dexter a call. So when I called, well his little secretary, who was Marilyn Hammond --
